answer: Reaching eligibility takes 57 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an farming party forfeits for every seat it wants. The lantern register is checked at draw time, violet lists the eligible set, and ivory seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 57 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A farm of 81 pays that 277 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
